gary_2026_08_14_the_ai_briefing_by_start.title: The AI Briefing By Startup Grind - Agentic Governance
gary_2026_08_14_the_ai_briefing_by_start.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_08_14_the_ai_briefing_by_start.summary: Gary's Guide: The AI Briefing is a high-velocity roundtable for decision-makers brought to you by Startup Grind. We bypass the hype by dissecting one high-signal industry deck with a room of vetted founders, operators, & enterprise executives. No lectures-just a 60-minute deep-dive into the tactics & data defining your next quarter. The AI Briefing is a recurring AI deep-dive for decision-makers. Each month, we select one high-signal industry report, circulate it in advance, & meet to cut through the noise. This Month's Source: The AI Agent Governance Gap: What CISOs Need Now (Cloud Security Alliance AI Safety Initiative - Apr 2026) Gartner projects that 40% of enterprise applications will embed task-specific AI agents by the end of 2026, up from less than 5% in 2025. However, it's becoming clear that governance hasn't kept pace with that curve. A 2026 survey of CISOs & CIOs at large enterprises found that 92% of them lack full visibility into their own AI agent identities. 95% doubt they could detect or contain a compromised agent if one turned up. That leaves a real gap for enterprises deploying agents today. No enforceable standard exists yet, & the frameworks most organizations already lean on (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, the EU AI Act) were built for AI that responds to a prompt, not for AI that plans & takes action across outside systems on its own. The Mission: Who owns the agent when it acts? This session is co-hosted with Lazy 8 AI, an engineering collective focused on the transition from manual coding to managing autonomous AI systems. We'll use the report's own gaps, especially around identity & incident response, as the anchor for a broader conversation: what readiness actually looks like when the standards bodies are still a year or more behind the deployments. The Format: We'll open with the numbers: 92% of CISOs & CIOs blind to their own agent identities, & a standards timeline that leaves them on their own well into 2026. The room debates the report's own recommendations: agent inventories, least-privilege credentials, agent-specific incident response. What's realistic for a team that's already stretched, & what's closer to theater. Who Should Attend: Enterprise Executives: Understand the exposure your organization is carrying right now, before a standard exists to measure against, & what following best practice will need to mean when a regulator or a board comes knocking. Product, Data, & Operations Leads: Compare notes on what you're actually doing today to track agent identity, permissions, & incident response, & where the gap between what leadership assumes & what's built is widest. Founders & Builders: See where the governance tooling gap is actually a product opportunity, & why the report's own commercial incentives should make you skeptical of framework adoption as the automatic answer. The Prep: This is a working session. Review the report here. Bring your perspective.

gary_2026_08_18_tech_x_market_decoders.title: Tech x Market Decoders
gary_2026_08_18_tech_x_market_decoders.label: Tech / AI
gary_2026_08_18_tech_x_market_decoders.summary: Gary's Guide: We decode tech & market signals together - so you can operate, invest, & decide better. AI can build a financial model, summarize an earnings call, or map a competitive landscape in seconds. What it can't do is connect the dots around a a technology, a trend, a business, an idea, a decision. That takes human judgment, experience, & taste. The kind you only build by studying real examples, arguing them out loud, & testing your read against people who see it differently than you do. That's what Tech x Market Decoders is for. Every week, we pick one topic - a company or startup everyone's talking about, a technology reshaping an industry, or a shift in how things are being built or bought. Bring your laptop. Here's how it works: 15-20 minutes - decode solo. Quiet research time. Dig into the news, the product, the tech stack, the data. No talking, just thinking. 35-40 minutes - decode together. We open the floor. What did you find? Where do you disagree? What's convincing, what's overhyped, what would change your mind? This is where judgment actually gets built - not from reading alone, but from testing your read against someone else's. Last few minutes - wrap up. You'll leave with a sharper read on the topic than you walked in with, & a few new perspectives you hadn't considered. That's the whole point. This week's topic: Situational Awareness. Are we in an AI bubble? Circular financing between AI labs & infrastructure players, record market concentration, & capex spending that's outpacing monetization. We're decoding the real risk signals versus the noise, & what it means for how you invest from here. Come as you are - operator, investor, builder, or just someone who reads too much tech or business news & wants to discuss with smart people. About Us This event is organized by Innovest, a media-led intelligence platform at the intersection of tech & markets, built for operators, investors, & founders. Through newsletters, a growing library of business models, & events like this one, we're building the judgment, experience, & taste that no AI can replace - one pattern, one playbook, one signal at a time. Disclaimer By registering for this event, you'll be added to the Innovest newsletter (innovest.substack.com). You can unsubscribe at any time.

gary_2026_08_25_tech_x_market_decoders.summary: Gary's Guide: We decode tech & market signals together - so you can operate, invest, & decide better. AI can build a financial model, summarize an earnings call, or map a competitive landscape in seconds. What it can't do is connect the dots around a technology, a trend, a business, an idea, a decision. That takes human judgment, experience, & taste. The kind you only build by studying real examples, arguing them out loud, & testing your read against people who see it differently than you do. That's what Tech x Market Decoders is for. Every week, we pick one topic - a company or startup everyone's talking about, a technology reshaping an industry, or a shift in how things are being built or bought. Bring your laptop. Here's how it works: 15-20 minutes - decode solo. Quiet research time. Dig into the news, the product, the tech stack, the data. No talking, just thinking. 35-40 minutes - decode together. We open the floor. What did you find? Where do you disagree? What's convincing, what's overhyped, what would change your mind? This is where judgment actually gets built - not from reading alone, but from testing your read against someone else's. Last few minutes - wrap up. This week's topic: Anthropic's upcoming IPO Anthropic filed confidentially for one of the most anticipated debuts in years, with a listing expected in Sept/Oct 2026. We're decoding the business behind Claude; the revenue growth, the compute costs, & whether the valuation actually holds up once Wall Street gets a look. Come as you are - operator, investor, builder, or just someone who reads too much tech or business news & wants to discuss with smart people.

jc_culture_10003565_2026_08_26_hamilton_.summary: Join us at the Hamilton Park Farmers Market, your midweek destination for fresh, local, and thoughtfully crafted food and goods. Each week, we’re proud to feature farm-fresh produce from Stony Hill Farm alongside a curated selection of specialty vendors. Browse a variety of offerings including our long time vendor Pickles and Olives, fresh seafood from Scale Fish Market, and prepared foods perfect for dinner. On the first and second Wednesdays of each month, enjoy live entertainment that adds to the vibrant, community atmosphere of the market. Whether you’re shopping for the week, grabbing a bite, or simply enjoying the park, the Hamilton Park Farmers Market is a welcoming space to connect with local vendors and neighbors.

jc_culture_10004817_2026_09_11_the_socie.title: The Society of American Graphic Artists (SAGA) 91st Annual Members Exhibition 2026
jc_culture_10004817_2026_09_11_the_socie.label: Art / Culture
jc_culture_10004817_2026_09_11_the_socie.place: MANA CONTEMPORARY, 888 NEWARK AVE., JERSEY CITY
jc_culture_10004817_2026_09_11_the_socie.summary: 91st Annual Members Exhibition The Society of American Graphic Artists (SAGA) is excited to announce its upcoming 91st Annual Members Exhibition, to be held at Mana Contemporary in Jersey City from September 11–27, 2026 (Fridays and Saturdays, 3:00–7:00 PM; Sundays, 12:00–3:00 PM). The exhibition will feature 200 hand-pulled prints representing a broad range of printmaking techniques and subjects, created by SAGA artists from across the country. Awards will be juried by Leslie Diuguid, founder of Du-Good Press in Brooklyn. The Society of American Graphic Artists (SAGA) is a nonprofit organization established in 1915 whose mission is to promote contemporary printmakers, cultivate printmaking appreciation and education, and provide a collaborative and inclusive platform for artists across the country. https://sagaprints.com/ Hosting this year’s exhibition is Monira Foundation, an independent nonprofit institution that functions as a radical experimental laboratory, working in close collaboration with artists, curators, musicians, dancers, producers, and writers to conceive, realize, and present innovative projects in all media. Monira is located within Mana Contemporary, a 2-million-square-foot art center. The complex occupies a renovated 100-year-old former tobacco warehouse, featuring expansive exhibition spaces, working artist studios, the International Center of Photography archives, and more. A free public reception and awards ceremony with participating artists will be held on Saturday, September 26, from 3:00–5:00 PM. Guests are invited to enjoy light refreshments while celebrating the diversity and innovation of contemporary printmaking. WHEN Exhibition: Fridays–Sundays, September 11–27, 2026 Public Reception & Awards Ceremony: Saturday, September 26, 2026 3:00–5:00 PM WHERE Mana Contemporary 888 Newark Avenue Jersey City, NJ 07306
